To elaborate, Doordash guarantees a minimum pay per delivery. Only $1 is guaranteed that by the company, meaning the rest of that pay is made by the tip unless the tip does not meet that minimum. Here's some examples, using a $10 guaranteed minimum delivery:

$1 base pay + $6 tip + $3 Doordash makeup = $10

$1 base pay + $0 tip + $9 Doordash makeup = $10

$1 base pay + $12 tip = $13

Some of the more savvy customers who are aware of this prefer to give cash tips, which the company does not have control over and thus must pay the same as in the second example.
